tests.name: safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios splits an amount evenly, assigning the remainder to the first ratio
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios splits an amount proportionally across three ratios with no remainder
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios allocates everything to a single ratio
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios returns one Dinero object per ratio
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios preserves the original currency on every resulting share
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios allows a zero ratio alongside a positive one, giving it nothing
safeAllocate successful allocation with plain-number ratios does not mutate the original Dinero object data
safeAllocate ratio normalization across scales normalizes same-scale object ratios and raises the result scale accordingly
safeAllocate ratio normalization across scales normalizes mixed plain-number and scaled-object ratios to the highest scale
safeAllocate ratio normalization across scales scales proportional object ratios that all share a non-zero scale
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when given an empty ratios array
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when a plain-number ratio is negative
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when a scaled-object ratio is negative
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when every ratio is zero
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when the only ratio provided is zero
safeAllocate invalid ratios throws when ratios mix a negative value with zeros
